map.素数（质数）是大于 1 的自然数，且只能被 1 和它本身整除。: A prime is a natural number greater than 1 divisible only by 1 and itself.

map.• 算术基本定理：每个大于 1 的自然数都能唯一地分解为素数的乘积: • Fundamental theorem of arithmetic: every natural number greater than 1 has a unique prime factorisation

map.n 为素数 ⇔ n>1 且不存在 p ∈ [2, √n] 使 p | n: n is prime ⇔ n>1 and no p ∈ [2, √n] divides n
map.素性判定采用试除到 √n（辅以小素数预筛与 6k±1 步进加速）；区间筛法用埃拉: Primality uses trial division up to √n (with small-prime pre-sieving and 6k±1 stepping); range sieving uses the Sieve of Eratosthenes to list all primes in the range.
map.素数判定与生成（本页代码口径）：n 为素数 ⇔ n≥2 且不存在因数 p≤√n；: Prime testing and generation (per this page's code): n is prime ⇔ n≥2 and no factor p≤√n exists; the implementation trial-divides by 6k±1 (n<2 not prime, n<4 prime, evens not prime, multiples of 3 only 3 itself, i starting at 5 stepping by 6 testing i and i+2 until i²>n); range enumeration uses the sieve of Eratosthenes, the Nth/first N primes (N limits 10⁶/10⁵ respectively), and factorization trial-divides from 2 until d²>n. Validation: single-number testing requires n to be a positive integer, ranges require 1≤from≤to, and an over-limit N prompts and stops. Grading: outputs "is/is not prime" with neighboring primes, counts, timing and other details.
